edit_summary: Replaced Q18 #pragma omp atomic with thread-local dense arrays and parallel post-loop merge, eliminating ~60M atomic operations per batch run.
rationale: The Q18 branch executes an atomic double-add on every single lineitem row (~60M for SF10) to a shared array indexed by orderkey. Atomic double operations on x86 use compare-and-swap loops costing ~20-50ns each, yielding ~1.2-3.0s of overhead. Replacing with thread-local calloc'd arrays (lazy-allocated, so only touched pages consume physical memory) and a parallel merge pass eliminates all contention.
